description: ES256 on a P-256 and a P-384 key returns the P-256 key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): ES256 is served by a P-256 key only (RFC 7518 §3.4), so the P-384 member is out; member 0 has no alg, use (U = sig from ES256) or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
